newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FORECAST - Ayala Land 96 net seen rising.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Ayala Land 96 net seen rising.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc (ALI), the country's leading real estate company, is likely to show a 37 percent rise in net profits to 4.254 billion pesos in 1996 from 3.108 billion pesos in 1995, according to a Reuters poll.
The poll of seven brokerage houses completed this week showed the momentum in earnings growth would continue in 1997 with a 25 percent net profit rise to 5.333 billion pesos.
ALI is the property arm of conglomerate Ayala Corp. It is scheduled to announce its 1996 earnings later this month or early in February.
In the first nine months of 1996, Ayala Land posted net profits of 3.27 billion pesos, 34 percent higher than 2.43 billion pesos in the year-earlier period.

Respondents said ALI would show increased profit despite a widely-expected cooling-off in Manila property prices this year because of its diversification into other parts of the Philippines and from its high recurring rentals.

"ALI is best positioned to survive and benefit from the property sector's consolidation given its solid balance sheet (a net cash balance of five billion pesos) and recurring rental profits of at least 1.5 billion pesos per year," ING Barings Securities said in a report.
